name: phase_1_email_triage_examples
description: Small labeled dataset for testing the Phase 1 AI inbox triage classifier.

input.subject: VOD.L stock stopped trading
input.body:
Hi team,

Why did this POV order stop trading before market close?
It was supposed to trade on MOC - PUKOID3234234234

Regards,
Trader

expected_output.reason: The sender reports that an order stopped trading before market close, which could indicate trading or client impact.

input.subject: <instance> stats check request
input.body:
Hi team,

Can you run this admin command on <instance>?

admincmd <cmd>

admincmd <cmd2>

please paste me the output thx

Regards,
Dev

expected_output.reason: A developer is asking support to run admin commands and return the output, but there is no incident or trading impact mentioned.
